Provenance audit of one note: list every number that appears in the note's theorem statements and 'Result up front' (thresholds, constants, counts), and for each find the line of the runner's stdout (logs/runner-cache/<runner>.txt or a fresh run) or the spec output that produces it. Write the table as a script under probes/work/<stub>/provenance.py that prints one line per number: `<number> | <where produced> | OK/UNSOURCED` and a final `SUMMARY: n numbers, m unsourced`; print `HIT: unsourced numbers` if m > 0. Run it through run_probe with --extra 'python3 probes/work/<stub>/provenance.py'. Never edit the note.

For one open science PR: fetch its refuting control (`git show origin/<branch>:.claude/science/physics-loops/<pack>/specs/<name>_refuter.py > probes/work/<stub>/refuter.py`), change its random seeds and, where it has them, its sizes or couplings, run it, and compare its verdict lines with the committed .out.txt on the branch. Print `HIT: ...` on any inconsistency and a `SUMMARY:` line; run through run_probe with --extra. Commit the fetched script with the log so the run is reproducible.
